title: 第5章 看见希望第6章 灵谷成熟
content_zh:
;;
一整天，陈平就在山坡和猪舍之间来回奔波。
割草，背草，再割草，再背草……
沉重的背篓压得他佝偻着腰，肩膀被粗糙的背带磨破了皮，火辣辣地疼。
汗水流进伤口，更是钻心的刺痛。
那几个负责剁草的壮汉，则坐在一旁阴凉处，时不时吆喝几声，催他动作快些。
中午时分，监工提着桶来了。
这次拿来的东西，会稍好一些，且量会大一些！
一人一碗稀粥！
陈平几乎是抢过来，拿着一个大碗，顾不上烫，几口就灌了下去。
那点东西下肚，竟头一次感觉到了饱腹感！
这让陈平觉得不可思议……
下午，他被安排去清理一个角落里的粪池。
那是个巨大的深坑，里面积满了黑绿的粘稠污物，蛆虫翻滚，臭气熏天，几乎能让人窒息。
他和其他两个苦力，用长柄木瓢，一瓢一瓢地将污物舀出来，倒进旁边的粪车里。
沉重的木瓢，污秽的飞溅，无孔不入的恶臭，熏得他头晕眼花，胃里翻腾。
就在他咬牙忍着呕吐的欲望，机械地重复着舀粪的动作时……
眼角余光瞥见粪池另一头，两个杂役拖着一卷破草席过来。
草席的一角散开，露出一只青灰的、沾满污垢的脚。
“晦气！又死一个！”

其中一个杂役骂骂咧咧，脸上没有丝毫波动，像是拖着一捆柴火。
“老毛病了吧？熬不住就早点投胎，省得占地方。”
另一个随口应着。
两人走到粪池边缘，随意地一甩手。那卷草席划出一道弧线。
噗通！
重重砸进粘稠的黑绿粪污里，溅起大片污秽。
草席散开一点，隐约能看到里面包裹着一具干瘦的躯体，脸朝下……
躯体迅速被污物吞没，只留下几缕花白的头发漂浮在表面，很快也沉了下去。
就像丢一块没用的抹布……
陈平握着木瓢的手猛地一紧，指关节捏得发白。
胃里的翻腾瞬间被一股冰冷的寒意冻结。
那具被随意丢弃的尸体，像一块沉重的石头，狠狠砸在他的心口。
他认识那张脸，或者说，认识那几缕花白的头发。
是窝棚区另一个角落的老张头，比他早来好多年。
平时沉默寡言，佝偻得像只虾米，咳嗽起来，像是要把肺都咳出来。
昨天好像还看见他在费力地劈柴……
就这么没了？
像垃圾一样，丢进了粪池？
一股难言的凉意，从脚底板直冲天灵盖。
陈平死死盯着那逐渐恢复平静、只剩下气泡冒出的污秽池面。
content_en:
;;
All day long, Chen Ping ran back and forth between the hillside and the pig house.
Cut the grass, carry the grass, cut the grass again, carry the grass again...
The heavy backpack made his waist stoop, and his shoulders were abraded by the rough straps, causing him a burning pain.
Sweat flowed into the wound, making it even more painful.
The strong men responsible for chopping grass sat in the shade and shouted from time to time, urging him to move faster.
At noon the overseer came with a bucket.
The things I brought this time will be slightly better and the quantity will be larger!
A bowl of porridge for each person!
Chen Ping almost grabbed it, holding a big bowl, and drank it in a few mouthfuls without caring about scalding it.
After eating that little thing, I felt full for the first time!
This makes Chen Ping feel incredible...
In the afternoon, he was assigned to clean a cesspool in a corner.
It was a huge deep pit, filled with black and green sticky filth, maggots rolling around, and a stench that could almost make people suffocate.
He and two other coolies used long-handled wooden ladles to scoop out the dirt and poured it into the dung cart next to it.
The heavy wooden ladle, the splash of filth, and the all-pervasive stench made him dizzy and made his stomach churn.
Just as he gritted his teeth and resisted the desire to vomit, he mechanically repeated the action of scooping out feces...
From the corner of his eye, he saw two handymen dragging a roll of broken straw mats over from the other side of the cesspool.
A corner of the straw mat spread out, revealing a gray, dirt-stained foot.
"Bad luck! Another one dies!"
One of the handymen was cursing, his face unmoved, as if he was dragging a bundle of firewood.
"Is this an old habit? If you can't bear it, reincarnate as soon as possible to save space."
The other responded casually.
The two walked to the edge of the cesspit and waved their hands casually. The rolled straw mat drew an arc.
Plop!
It hit hard into the thick black and green feces, splashing a large amount of filth.
The straw mat is spread out a little, and you can vaguely see a thin body wrapped inside, face down...
The body was quickly swallowed up by the filth, leaving only a few strands of gray hair floating on the surface, and soon sank.
It's like throwing away a useless rag...
Chen Ping's hand holding the wooden ladle tightened suddenly, and his knuckles turned white.
The churning in his stomach was instantly frozen by an icy chill.
The carelessly discarded body hit him hard in the heart like a heavy stone.
He knew that face, or rather, those strands of gray hair.
It was Lao Zhangtou from another corner of the slum area, who had been here many years before him.
He is usually taciturn, and is as stooped as a shrimp. When he coughs, it feels like he wants to cough out his lungs.
I seem to have seen him struggling to chop wood yesterday...
Just gone?
Like garbage, thrown into the cesspool?
An unspeakable coolness rushed from the soles of his feet to the sky.
Chen Ping stared intently at the filthy pool surface that gradually returned to calm, with only bubbles left.
